moments.title: Rugby Nations Championship Finals Weekend
moments.blurb: The inaugural Nations Championship concludes with Finals Weekend at Twickenham, featuring England, Wales, and the Grand Final.

angles.name: Grand Finale Build-up
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Rugby Nations Championship Finals Weekend kicks off at Twickenham this Friday. Who are you backing for the Grand Final?

angles.name: England vs All Blacks Rematch
angles.copy: England face a huge rematch against the All Blacks in the 3rd place play-off this Saturday at Twickenham. Can they secure the win?

angles.name: Wales in Play-off
angles.copy: Wales take on Japan in the 9th place play-off this Saturday as the Nations Championship reaches its climax. Dydd Gêm Mawr!

moments.title: Premier League: Arsenal vs Man City
moments.blurb: A massive Premier League clash sees title rivals Arsenal host Manchester City at the Emirates Stadium this Sunday.

angles.name: Top of the Table Clash
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Manchester City this Sunday! A huge Premier League showdown with massive title implications. Who's taking all three points?

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Super Sunday football just got bigger. Arsenal face Man City in a blockbuster fixture that could define their season. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix

angles.name: Season Finale Buzz
angles.copy: The F1 season finale is almost here! The Abu Dhabi Grand Prix weekend kicks off on December 4th. Who's ready for one last dose of drama?

angles.name: Yas Marina Circuit
angles.copy: Yas Marina Circuit awaits! The final race of the Formula 1 calendar is always a spectacle. What are your predictions for Abu Dhabi?

angles.name: London Calling
